categories.main_business_segments: Beijing HyperStrong Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of electrochemical energy storage systems. The company provides comprehensive energy storage system products and one-stop integrated solutions for traditional power generation, new energy power generation, smart grids, and end power users across the entire 'source-grid-load' chain. Its product portfolio includes large-scale energy storage systems, industrial and commercial energy storage solutions, battery management systems, energy management systems, power conversion systems, and cloud-based intelligent operation platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses full-stack self-developed capabilities covering battery cell modeling, digital intelligent closed-loop verification, battery management systems (BMS), thermal management, energy storage converters (PCS), system integration, power coordination control systems, and full lifecycle intelligent operation and maintenance. It employs advanced technologies such as AI-driven big data analytics, digital twin modeling, modular liquid cooling, and high-voltage cascade designs. Production utilizes intelligent manufacturing bases with automated assembly lines, AGVs, robotic arms, and CCD inspection systems to ensure high efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large state-owned energy enterprises, power grid companies, new energy power plants, industrial and commercial users, and specialized sectors such as oil fields, communication base stations, data centers, and emergency power supply. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant market share in China and expanding presence in Europe, the Americas, Australia, and emerging markets in the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Latin America, and Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing and R&D centers in Beijing, Zhuhai, Jiuquan, and other locations. It has established subsidiaries and sales networks in overseas markets including the United States, Germany, Singapore, Australia, and the United Kingdom. The company is actively expanding its global footprint through partnerships and direct project deliveries in Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: HyperStrong operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy storage supply chain, focusing on system integration, manufacturing of energy storage modules and systems, and providing technical services. It controls core components such as BMS, PCS, and thermal management systems through self-development and production, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or battery cell manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with increased R&D investment, focusing on AI-enabled energy storage lifecycle management, digital twin technology, advanced battery modeling, and integrated system solutions. It emphasizes developing high-safety, high-efficiency, long-life, and intelligent energy storage products. Strategic initiatives include expanding global market presence, enhancing intelligent manufacturing capabilities, and promoting sustainable green development aligned with China's dual carbon goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of energy storage system products and related technical services. The company adopts a direct sales model with self-determined pricing based on cost and market conditions. It also derives income from leasing new energy vehicles and providing technical consulting services. Government subsidies and incentives contribute to other income streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: HyperStrong is a leading player in China's electrochemical energy storage system integration market, ranked first domestically by installed capacity and project scale. Globally, it ranks among the top three battery energy storage system integrators by newly installed capacity. The company competes with major battery manufacturers, PCS providers, and electrical equipment firms, leveraging its comprehensive technology stack, product quality, and extensive project experience to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 8.27 billion, representing an 18.44% year-over-year increase, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 647.8 million, up 12.06%. Total assets reached RMB 10.97 billion, growing 18.83%, with shareholders' equity of RMB 3.14 billion, up 31.72%. The company maintains a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding domestic and international markets and increased R&D spending.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: HyperStrong emphasizes product safety, reliability, long service life, and high intelligence as its core value propositions. Its energy storage systems feature high integration density, modular liquid cooling, advanced AI-driven lifecycle management, and superior battery health estimation accuracy. The company offers tailored solutions for diverse application scenarios, including grid support, renewable energy integration, industrial peak shaving, and emergency power, delivering enhanced operational efficiency and economic benefits to customers.
